subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking from New York to London on November 15th, 2021, has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary details are as follows: Flight number: AB1234 Departure: New York, JFK at 10:00 AM Arrival: London, Heathrow at 10:00 PM Seat: 15A We look forward to welcoming you on board. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. Best regards, The Airline Team
